# WO-613: Learn each site's access from the person's own connection, and pick the fastest working method automatically
Status: queued (in-house)
Vendor: claude
Agent: automation-engineer (Theo Park)
Kind: engine
Tier: deep
Severity: HIGH
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes
Target release: 0.4
Source: owner direction 2026-11-11 ("find a way to fully automate"), after WO-601 showed every people-search page blocks a cloud fetch. PII-free by rule.
Boundary (all WOs 612-616): shared rule 5 stands. No CAPTCHA solving, no stealth plugins, no solver services, no UA or fingerprint spoofing, no proxies or IP rotation. "Fully automated" here means: the app does every step a machine may do, from the person's own computer, and asks the person only for the one click a site reserves for humans, batched so it happens rarely.

## Goal
`search_access` in the registry is one global value, measured from our own machines. Access really depends on where the request comes from. Each install should learn, locally, which method works for each site, and use the cheapest one that works: plain fetch -> headless page load -> attended window (WO-612) -> hand check.

## Design
1. Local table (store, per data folder, never sent anywhere): broker id, method, last outcome enum (ok / challenge / http_403 / http_429 / no_results / parse_error), timestamp, consecutive-failure count.
2. Method choice per broker: start from the registry value; a method that succeeded in the last 30 days is tried first; a method that hit challenge or 403 twice is skipped for 14 days and the next method up is used. Never more than one request per site per run, never retry a 403 in the same run.
3. `freemyid doctor` / dashboard show "Searches automatically: N sites; needs you: M sites".
4. Optional, owner decision later: an opt-in, anonymous "which method worked" count to improve the shipped registry. NOT in this WO (site and app stay telemetry-free).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Fake-clock tests: promotion after success, demotion after 2 failures, 14-day expiry, one request per site per run.
2. No new network call is introduced; only the choice of method changes.
3. Table holds no URLs, names or page content (schema test).

## Allowed paths
- `src/freemyid/engine/exposure.py`, `src/freemyid/engine/tiers.py`, new `src/freemyid/engine/access_memory.py`
- `tests/test_access_memory.py` (new)
- `docs/handoff/automation-engineer.md`
Store schema change = contract (`storage/`): send the migration to the orchestrator.

## Required checks
`.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_access_memory.py tests/test_exposure*.py tests/test_tiers*.py`, ruff, full suite.
